title.narrative: Strengthening Multistakeholder Engagement through the UNESCO MIL Alliance

description.narrative: UNESCO will strengthen multistakeholder engagement and international cooperation through the Media and Information Literacy (MIL) Alliance as a key global platform for dialogue, partnership-building and collaborative action to advance media and information literacy for all. Bringing together stakeholders from academia, civil society, educational institutions, youth and media communities, the MIL Alliance will continue to foster inclusive exchanges, knowledge-sharing, research and cooperation that promote critical thinking, access to reliable information, freedom of expression, intercultural dialogue and ethical participation in digital and media environments. Through advocacy, capacity-building and collaborative initiatives, the MIL Alliance will place media and information literacy, user empowerment and ethical engagement with information and media at the centre of inclusive and human-centred societies. The initiative will also support the advancement of UNESCO’s MIL Cities Initiative, which promotes the integration of media and information literacy into local governance, public services, cultural institutions and community initiatives. By fostering peer-learning and collaboration among cities, the initiative positions urban spaces as drivers of inclusive digital transformation and citizen engagement, translating global MIL principles into concrete local action.
